rules.title: Official product name
rules.statement: The official product name is BFC.

rules.title: Official visual reference
rules.statement: Interface e Menu is the official visual reference and its layout, colors, composition and style must be preserved unless a visual change is explicitly approved.

rules.title: No competitive pay-to-win
rules.statement: Purchases and cosmetics cannot grant gameplay-stat advantages in the official competitive ruleset.

rules.title: Digital button football
rules.statement: BFC remains a digital button-football game based on discrete aimed physical actions rather than continuous character control.

rules.title: Aim, power and release interaction
rules.statement: The primary action preserves selection, direction, power feedback and release; device-specific mappings may differ.

rules.title: Resolve physics before next tactical action
rules.statement: A new competitive tactical action cannot begin while the previous physical state is still unresolved.

rules.title: Competitive actions per possession
rules.statement: Official competitive modes preserve the concept of up to three consecutive actions per possession, subject to explicit possession-loss rules.

rules.title: Essential local modes
rules.statement: BFC supports P1 vs COM and P1 vs P2 as essential local play modes.

rules.title: Shot action
rules.statement: Shot is the normal-power direct piece action controlled by player aim and power.

rules.title: Pass action
rules.statement: Pass is intentionally more controlled and has reduced maximum power relative to a normal shot; the exact coefficient is tunable.

rules.title: Spin action
rules.statement: BFC supports player-intended spin/curve with tunable strength and control mapping.

rules.title: Chip or airborne action
rules.statement: BFC preserves an action that lifts the ball over eligible obstacles; trajectory parameters are tunable.

rules.title: Contextual action access
rules.statement: Special actions remain available through a clear contextual/radial interaction concept across supported input devices.

rules.title: Automatic competitive goalkeeper
rules.statement: The goalkeeper is automatic in official competitive rulesets that adopt the legacy competitive behavior.

rules.title: Meaningful physical properties
rules.statement: Mass, restitution, friction and related physical properties remain meaningful while their numeric values are tunable and must never create invalid infinite acceleration or deadlock.

rules.title: Frame-rate independent gameplay
rules.statement: Gameplay physics must not depend on render refresh rate; equivalent initial states and inputs must remain equivalent within defined tolerances.

rules.title: Competitive parity
rules.statement: Official competitive rulesets standardize or normalize gameplay-affecting field, ball and piece attributes.

rules.title: Functional P1 vs COM AI
rules.statement: P1 vs COM uses AI that selects valid pieces and executes valid actions through the same gameplay rule validation as a player.

rules.title: Liga Justa identity
rules.statement: Liga Justa remains an official standardized competitive mode with no pay-to-win gameplay advantage.

rules.title: Campeonato identity
rules.statement: Campeonato remains a competitive mode distinct from Liga Justa with its own progression or tournament structure.

rules.title: Progress on valid defeat
rules.statement: A valid defeat may still award progression or reward; losing does not automatically zero all session progression.

rules.title: Persistent profile
rules.statement: Relevant profile, settings and progression persist across sessions through versioned save data.

rules.title: Trophy showcase
rules.statement: Earned achievements or trophies can feed the player's visual showcase/profile.

rules.title: Explicit shop ownership states
rules.statement: Shop items clearly distinguish locked, acquirable, owned and equipped/selected states.

rules.title: Mode-specific team composition and large-field eleven
rules.statement: Team composition and field formation are mode/ruleset data. The large-field profile uses 11 total pieces per team: 10 outfield pieces plus 1 goalkeeper included in the total. Legacy-derived modes preserve their reference compositions through configuration, and Training/Challenges may define scenario-specific field sizes, piece counts and formations.

rules.title: Out-of-bounds and restarts
rules.statement: Final rules for out-of-bounds, possession transfer and restarts require explicit approval before implementation becomes normative.

rules.title: Fouls, advantage and penalties
rules.statement: Exact foul, advantage and penalty rules require explicit Product Owner specification before becoming normative.
